CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to any identified content was present.

COD.rationale: Content (red positions) is identified and an explicit origin/status entry is present for the same referent/time; the red set also describes the presented organization.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-condition claim tied to identified content was present.

C.rationale: The report explicitly identifies content sets (red and blue) for the named referent and time.

D.rationale: An explicit origin/status entry (origin=...) is provided separately from the content-identifying fields for the same referent/time.

O.rationale: The report shows how content is presented as spatial sets (positions for red) and gives a display coordinate convention.
